mapper.select: select ppa_value from prepay_parameters where ppa_name in ('PREFIJOS_GSM_CPP') and rownum = 1
select count(1) from prepay_cellulars where pce_handle = #{handle}
mapper.insert: insert into cellular_number_changes (cnc_handle, cnc_clu_cellular, cnc_add_date, cnc_last_update_date, cnc_start_date, cnc_end_date) values (#{handle}, #{cellularNumber}, sysdate, sysdate, sysdate, null)

insert into pp_service_status (pss_handle, pss_clu_cellular_number, pss_activation_date, pss_pcs_id_actual, pss_start_date, pss_last_updated_date) values (#{handle}, #{cellularNumber}, sysdate, #{statusPpay}, sysdate, sysdate)
